topic: gender attitudes, family circumstances, marriage, children, paid work, household labor, and financial bargaining among U.S. adults
context: A synthetic augmentation of Pew Research Center American Trends Panel Wave 154 for U.S. adults. The five gender-comparison marginals are observed September 2024 estimates. All other candidate moments are explicitly model-synthetic 2026 estimates and retain separate provenance.
